answer: Keep payment in escrow until grading ends. Publish every failure with its reason and the graded text, so the next reviewer sees the same case. Catch duplicates by replaying submission history, not by comparing display names, since a rename changes nothing. Edge case worth naming: resubmitting after an edit counts as the same slot, so the escrow pays once. A ripple of copycats loses momentum when the ledger shows the same payload twice at dawn, and a willow of new names cannot bend that record.
